title: Snapmaker U1 3D Printer $1299 + Shipping @ Snapmaker AU
body:
Deal: Snapmaker U1 3D Printer $1299 + Shipping @ Snapmaker AU

[toeachbyeach] How does this compare to the usual "for sale" or couponed pricing?
[FlyerOne] JB HiFi has them on pre-order with 2 x rolls of snapspeed PLA or Matt Pla. Same price.
https://www.jbhifi.com.au/products/snapmaker-u1-3d-printer
[Jimothy Wongingtons] Hell yea I got some gc to convert, makes it a spicy proposal…
[YoshiKara] No ability to use a referral/special discount code, doesnt release until the 15th of October, and more expensive shipping unless you are in WA it seems like. If you do have a good amount of discounted GCs it would be worth it though
[FlyerOne] Click and collect will be an option after release I dare say, but the price might have gone up by then.
I got one during the kickstarter. Very happy with it.
[YoshiKara] Yeah hopefully it wont be delivery only after release, might end up holding for a potential Black Friday deal
[RayEarth2133] Would be interesting to see if it makes to JB Business
[w33w00] I recently got this for $856.55 USD/$1217.21 AUD shipped direct from Snapmaker. Came with 4x rolls Snapseed PLA, colours yellow, white, black, red.
If getting from Snapmaker, make sure to enquire about the 5% discount code for students and those with disabilities.
[YoshiKara] Trying to purchase direct from Snapmaker now throws an incorrect shipping region error and informs you to use the AU store now so this is unfortunately not available anymore
[Lizard Spock] for students and those with disabilities
So Percy Jackson gets 10% off?
